d: Donald Trump is on the campaign trail with just days to go before America’s midterm elections. But with the cost of living weighing on voters, the president is making headlines for very different reasons - from an awkward remark about Nicki Minaj to jabs at LeBron James and France. Barack Obama is seizing the moment, mocking Trump’s White House renovations and rallying Democrats. Trump is firing back, while a Democratic Senate candidate is challenging the president’s attacks on his identity. Will Trump’s campaign rhetoric drown out voters’ economic concerns? Palki Sharma tells you.
